name: cmath-zhtw
description: A collection of mathematical problems presented in Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) intended to evaluate mathematical reasoning and problem-solving in Chinese. Problems require generating numeric or symbolic answers and often involve multi-step reasoning across topics such as arithmetic, algebra, and geometry. Designed to test models' ability to produce correct final answers and (optionally) intermediate solution steps.
evaluation_method: Exact match / accuracy on final answer; optionally evaluate intermediate steps for reasoning alignment
reputation: Relatively specialized dataset with limited but growing use for Chinese-language math reasoning evaluation.
